title: TouchSky
changeLog:
0.1.0:
• First release — a full Bluesky client for the HP TouchPad.
• Home timeline; post, reply, like, repost; long-press a picture to save it.
• Threads (ancestors + nested replies), profiles, follow/unfollow.
• Explore / Search for posts and people.
• Notifications, Feeds, Lists, Saved posts, and direct messages.
• Video playback (Bluesky HLS) through an on-device relay.
• Images and emoji rendered on-device.
• YouTube links open in the MeTube app; other links open in the browser (Atlas if installed).
